Vapes

Vapes & EJuice

Vaporizing is not a crime but selling tobacco to minors is.  At Gandalf's we check ID's and do not cater to the underage use of tobacco and nicotine. With that said, Gandalf's is your hub for all things vape, from rechargeable devices, flower vapes, concentrate vapes, nicotine salt vapes, and disposable vapes. 

 

We specialize in having the knowledge you want about vaping but don't necessarily want to research yourself.

We have many options of Vapes for Nicotine and for Cannabis vapes and CBD to give you the option of being a little more discrete. From disposables to reusables, we have a wide variety of disposable vapes to suit any vapers needs.

​

Brands we carry include; Smok, Geek vape, Voopoo, Yocan, Dr Dabber, Hamilton Devices, Hunibadger, Puffco , Focus V - makes Carta, Ispire daab, Mamasan, Ripe, Twist, Sad boy, Coastal Clouds, Cloud Nurdz, Four seasons - tobacco only flavor, Elf Bars, Esco bars, Flum, Swft mods, Geek’d, Blng, Juul, CBD, Infinite CBD, ablis CBD, Spacegods, Wyld Cbd, Hylyfe & More
